cards.title: Say pharmacy

articulation.label: pharmacy
articulation.alt: pharmacy: /f/ → /ɑ/ → /r/ → /m/ → /ə/ → /s/ → /i/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /f/: Upper teeth lightly touch the lower lip.
/r/: Bunch the tongue; leave space at the ridge.
/m/: Close both lips; air goes through the nose.
/ə/: Relax the tongue in the center.
/s/: Make a narrow gap near the ridge; let air flow.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
